title: Chapter 474
paragraphs: Chapter 474
Episode 133: Times of Choices (1)
When the main force of the Zipfel Matop and the support troops of the main family arrived, there were only fifteen people left in the Gaipa Army.
Five in Zipfel, five in Vermont, and five in Kinzelo.
The rest were all killed by Vigo and his knights, the Proch siblings.
The members of the 3rd force who had already lost all their power and morale couldn't stand a chance against Runcandel and the Proch siblings.
Vigo had thought it would be good to capture Sandra Zipfel alive during the process.
However, he made a very wise decision not to capture her since 'Murakan and Jin just left'.

It was because he recalled the fact that doing so would mean ignoring the guardian deity of the family and a rider who, although ranked lower in external hierarchy than himself, held a much higher actual position.
"Was it Vigo Runcandel? Kyahaha, he must have wanted to catch me badly, but he made a pretty smart decision."
Sandra chuckled and gulped down the fruit wine placed in front of her.
She was in the captain's room of the battleship Cojek. The other pure-blooded Zipels assigned as rescue support naturally moved to other places when she took over the captain's room.
"If he hadn't given up on capturing me, Vigo would have died today. Hmm, would our Jin have been sad? They didn't seem that close, though."
"Phew."
An old man sitting across from Sandra sighed heavily. He was an individual using the name 'Hedo' and served as the second-ranked butler of the Zipfel family.
Hedo, who didn't fit the image of a butler of the world's number one magic family, was also a muscular man. The squirming muscles revealed his extremely unpleasant mood.
"Young lady, you should have properly counterattacked even after Jin Runcandel left."
"Really?"
Hedo felt like his insides were turning upside down at Sandra's seemingly happy-go-lucky attitude.
"But even if not Vigo, our Jin would have definitely been sad if the Proch siblings died, Hedo. You have to think about that. Jin and I are in love."
Hedo scratched his head.
He had known better than anyone that Sandra was a completely crazy young lady since a long time ago.
But suddenly love? Dating?
'On top of that, the other party is none other than the 12th rider of Runcandel, what kind of cruel joke is this?'
He had never experienced this before.
However, one thing was certain. No matter what the reason was for suddenly deciding to love Jin, Sandra would never let go of that feeling in the future.
Sandra Zipfel, as Hedo had seen her, was that kind of person. A completely crazy kid, an uncompromising human being to the point of being horrifying!
It wasn't a matter of a normal love game or a temporary romantic emotion. It was hard to suppress his troubled heart.
"…And young lady, that arm. Are you really going to leave it like that?"
"Yes."
"Can't you recover? Why on earth would you leave it like that?"
"From now on, I can commemorate my encounter with him every time I see my severed right arm."
"But you're right-handed, Miss. You've always done everything primarily with your right hand..."
"I can eat with my left hand from now on."
"Surely, it will be inconvenient. Very much so."
He was so angry that his words were coming out in bursts.
"Kyahaha, it's okay. It's all for love!"
Clink!
Hedo took out a cigarette from his pocket and lit it. He inhaled deeply, and the whole cigarette burned like a fuse. As he exhaled, a cloud of smoke rushed out of the captain's quarters.
After he had gone through five cigarettes in an instant, his desire to shout and exert his anger seemed to subside slightly.
Hedo brushed his hair back and locked eyes with Sandra.
"Alright, fine. I understand. But what about the issue of technology leaks? Not only your right arm taken by Jin Runcandel, but the space-time device may also pose a significant problem."
The former issue could still be easily resolved. If Sandra simply attempted regeneration with the power of time rather than ordinary recovery, her sealed right arm would return.
'But she won't restore her arm until the time for recovery has passed.'
As for the latter, the 'space-time device' had a built-in mechanism to prevent technology leaks.
However, Hedo didn't trust such technology very much. The images of elders and technicians who claimed that there would be no leaks because they had prepared foolproof measures disgusted him.
"Yes, that's true. But Hedo,"
"Please speak, Miss."
"That's the only way my lover won't compete with our family, or at least something similar, right?"
Sandra smiled cunningly and continued.
"The gap between our Jin and our family is like an egg and a rock. Even if it's an incredibly tough egg. So, I thought it wouldn't be bad to give him that much of a chance."
"Ah, I see. You had such a deep meaning behind it."
Hedo nodded vaguely, seemingly giving up. Sandra laughed for a while, seemingly amused by his reaction.
"You understand me, right, Hedo?"
After stopping her laughter, Sandra spoke to Hedo. Hedo hesitated for a moment before answering.
"Yes, of course. For now, I will try my best to explain it to the family head."
"As expected, there's no one but Hedo. Hehe."
Land of the Beastmen, the Kinzelo headquarters.
"Kwaaak! Kkuaaak! It hurts, it's so painful! I think I'm going crazy! Kkiaak!"
Bouvar Gaston had been writhing in pain and screaming for days. Every time he twisted his body and let out a pig-like scream, his strangely swollen belly jiggled.
"Bring more sedatives, quickly!"
"Just kill meeee!"
The medical staff and beastmen who were barely holding Bouvar down were sweating profusely.
Berakt, Margiella, and the cold Jo stood at a distance, watching the scene.
"Ah, we are so close to our great undertaking. How could so many disasters come one after another?"
Jo clicked his tongue and spoke.
"Shut up, Jo. I'm already feeling suffocated, and your annoying voice just makes it worse."
"I'm sorry, Berakt."
"I said, shut up. Don't say a word. If you don't want to be eaten."
Jo turned his head, cursing inwardly.
Disasters.
As Jo said, Kinzelo had recently been facing a series of disasters.
During the attack on the Black Phoenix Castle, the leader had fallen ill due to overexerting his power. As if that wasn't enough, Zephrin went on a rampage, putting more strain on the leader's body.
And now, it was Bouvar's turn.
Although almost everyone in Kinzelo despised him, except for Margiella, Bouvar Gaston played an essential role in their grand undertaking.
The reason for Bouvar's suffering was due to the 'fusion' with Amela.
The fusion was not smooth, resulting in damage to Bouvar's soul and the chaos within.
If the leader had been in good condition, he could have quickly taken care of it, but now they could only administer sedatives.
Kinzelo had decided to appeal to Amela by showing that they knew more about 'chaos' than any other force.
Thus, Kinzelo's top warriors carried a portion of the chaos Bouvar possessed when they went to Gaifa Kundo. They used a method involving his sculptures.
The result was a huge success.
Amela was delighted to learn that chaos could fuse together, and the amplification could grant even greater power.
It seemed as if she had found a clue to the chaos she had been searching for alone. Amela did not even negotiate with other forces from that point on.
Because someone had talked to her through Bouvar's chaos.
"If you become my person, I will tell you everything you want to know about chaos," the voice had said, and it was strangely convincing.

"The leader, with his unwell body, personally sent a message to this Amela person. After the negotiation ended, he said that he should at least take the trouble to kill our warriors, but we decided to endure that as well."
Grinding his teeth in frustration, Berakht continued to clench his teeth as if he was about to go crazy from anger.
On the other side, in the treatment room, five white wolf and red tiger warriors who had returned alive from the Kaifa Gundo were receiving treatment.

"But Amella is dead, the warriors have been massacred, the survivors are so insane that they can't even distinguish between feces and urine, and Bubare is in that condition! We've not only gained nothing but also suffered severe damage."
Berakht couldn't understand how to accept the fact that Jin Runcandel was at the center of all this misfortune.
Margiella, who had been listening to the story, also wore a rare, somber expression.
"I'm sorry, Uncle Berakht. I didn't know Jin would be so uncooperative."
"…You don't have to apologize to me, Margiella! I'm just talking because I'm so frustrated. The Chief is in constant danger… Don't you think we need some changes?"
Berakht shrugged his shoulders, pointing to the map laid out before him.
On that map, there were several marks, and symbols representing Kinzelo, Runcandel, Zipfel, and Vermont were scattered about. It was a strategic map.
Pointing to a spot on the map where the symbols were gathered, Berakht continued.
"What if Jin Runcandel causes trouble here too? If he sabotages us again! What should we do?"
That place was where Jin had predicted in the Kaifa Gundo that there would be "something bigger than Amella."
"At that time…"
Margiella paused for a moment.
"At that time, I will seriously consider, Uncle Berakht, whether Jin really belongs with us."
"Right, we need to think about that."
"I hope Jin doesn't know what's going on here. If he continues to interfere, he will inevitably become our enemy."
"Hmm!"
Berakht didn't expect Margiella to be this calm, so he coughed awkwardly, revealing his embarrassment.
In fact, even if Margiella had been unreasonably angry, insisting she was right, Berakht had no other choice.
"Well, he probably doesn't know. If he did, he would've gone there first instead of looking for Amella."
"That's true, Uncle Berakht."
"By the way, it's a shame our vice-chief can't see that… Bubare's suffering like that, he would've enjoyed it."
"You're right, he would have loved it. But you know, Uncle Berakht? Bubare is our friend."
Meanwhile.
Runcandel's Black Knight, Dox Mcrolan, infiltrated Ricalton in the southern region of Huphester to carry out Jin's orders.
And while he was checking the underground prison of Ricalton's execution ground, he discovered a strange and horrifying phenomenon.
'What… exactly is this?'
